title: dependency_skipped
description: Event: a top-level embedded child its cached parent does not depend on, recorded by a #[Cacheable] put or a donut page write. The child carried neither an ETag nor a Surrogate-Key; the reason is what its body showed: `no_body` (null, on a donut page usually a hole) or `no_etag_or_surrogate_key` (set but untagged, usually a data dependency).
